question: Should `optimizeImages` on `OutboundMediaLoadOptions` and `maxDurationSeconds` on `transcodeAudioBufferToOpus` become supported permanent Plugin SDK API, or should the WhatsApp-specific requirements be kept behind a different owner boundary?
rationale: Both additions are small and reuse existing lower-level behavior, but Plugin SDK API expansion is compatibility-sensitive and the repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction before accepting a new or parallel plugin-facing contract.

options.title: Approve the shared media options
options.body: Treat the two typed options as supported Plugin SDK API and retain the focused facade and transcoding tests in this PR.

options.title: Keep the behavior owner-local
options.body: Reject one or both shared options and ask for a narrower WhatsApp implementation that does not expand the shared Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared media options
recommendation.body: Treat the two typed options as supported Plugin SDK API and retain the focused facade and transcoding tests in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct recent context for the WhatsApp production and adjacent live-QA behavior, though final API direction remains a broader maintainer choice.
